en.headline: Palace Museum Egypt exhibition closes on Monday
en.dek: Ancient Egypt Unveiled at the Hong Kong Palace Museum ends on 31 August after a nine-and-a-half-month run in West Kowloon.
body: The Hong Kong Palace Museum's special exhibition Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums ends on Monday, 31 August. Jointly organised with Egypt's Supreme Council of Antiquities, the show opened on 20 November 2025 and has been presented as the largest and longest display of ancient Egyptian objects staged in Hong Kong.

The museum said the exhibition brings together 250 objects from seven Egyptian museums and the Saqqara archaeological site, including statues, stelae, gold ornaments, mummy coffins and animal mummies. Four sections — The Land of Pharaohs, The World of Tutankhamun, The Secrets of Saqqara, and Ancient Egypt and the World — cover nearly 5,000 years of politics, belief, daily life and later finds from Saqqara.

The museum is at 8 Museum Drive in the West Kowloon Cultural District. Regular hours are 10am to 6pm on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, and 10am to 8pm on Friday, Saturday and public holidays. It is closed on Tuesdays except public holidays. Saturday hours therefore run until 8pm; Sunday and the final Monday close at 6pm.

A special exhibition ticket for Gallery 9, which also covers thematic galleries 1 to 7, is priced from HK$190 for adults and HK$95 for concessions, with morning and afternoon sessions. Full-access tickets covering other special exhibitions start from HK$230. Tickets are sold through the museum and West Kowloon channels. The museum said Gallery 9 is due to close from 1 September after the loan exhibition ends.

zh.headline: 香港故宮古埃及展周一結束
zh.dek: 香港故宮文化博物館「古埃及文明大展──埃及博物館珍藏」將於8月31日結束，西九展覽已舉行約九個半月。
body: 香港故宮文化博物館特別展覽「古埃及文明大展──埃及博物館珍藏」將於8月31日（星期一）結束。展覽由博物館與埃及最高文物委員會聯合主辦，自2025年11月20日開幕，館方形容是本港歷來規模最大、展期最長的古埃及文物展。
博物館表示，展覽匯集來自七間埃及博物館及薩卡拉考古遺址的250件展品，包括雕像、石碑、金器、木乃伊棺槤及動物木乃伊。展覽分為「法老的國度」、「圖坦卡門的世界」、「薩卡拉的秘密」及「古埃及與世界」四個單元，呈現近五千年的政治、信仰、日常生活，以及薩卡拉近年考古發現。
場地在西九文化區博物館道8號。開放時間為周一、三、四及周日上午10時至下午6時，周五、周六及公眾假期上午10時至晚上8時；除公眾假期外逢周二休館。換言之，本周六開放至晚上8時，周日及最後一天周一則於下午6時閉館。
第九展廳特別展覽門票（同時包括第一至七展廳專題展覽）成人票由190港元起、優惠票95港元，並設上午及下午時段。涵蓋其他特別展覽的全通票由230港元起，可經博物館及西九渠道購買。館方表示，借展結束後，第九展廳由9月1日起暫停開放。
